C1.for_what_part: These answers read the staged set against the approved list (missing and extra) and check for rows outside the named tables. They do not read the live tables. The tie to the live tables is the promotion's line in the record.

C2.for_what_part: Shown for the staged set: 100 case rows added and 100 account rows holding the fixed value. Not shown for the live tables after promotion.

C4.for_what_part: Shown for the staged changes: no deletions, no other table, no other column. The live tables are not read.

C7.for_what_part: Shows that the undo works on a copy at the time it is taken. It does not show that the worker still keeps what the undo needs. The record's tidy call and its reason field have to be read for that.

C8.for_what_part: Shows that the recipients equal those promoted and that the wording equals the approved wording, plus the number to send. The notices are not ordered yet at A2, so the orders themselves are not shown.

C9.for_what_part: Shows the confirmed and the unconfirmed sending calls against the release, as of the time it was taken. Duplicate calls are not clearly covered.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: An instrument that reads the live tables after the promotion, and one that checks the category against the requester's rule (C3). Also a plan-level check of the worker's reads (C5) and of the outbox (C10). The scope of a call and trace of a call instruments can only be asked for on named lines during the work, from the allowance of 50.
